role: Public control surface of VoiceConversationController: toggle/start/stop/interrupt, AI interjection streaming for workout prompts, spoken trigger handling with routine/urgent preemption and a capped pending-trigger queue; plus InterjectionGate, the consent gate for automatic AI lines.
types: InterjectionGate: enum — static maySend consent/enablement gate
state: clipboard: UIPasteboard.general via PasteboardWriter (urgent-trigger dictation save)
mem:VoiceConversationController.assistantObservers (also holds the one-shot typed-reply drain observer while voice is idle)

units.does: Toggle from the talk button: idle → start(); listening → finalize the turn; speaking → interrupt; starting → ignored. During a coach line (.triggerSpeaking) the line is never cut: with voice off behind it (preemptedState nil or .idle) the tap is kept as preemptedState .starting, so finishTriggerSpeech starts voice once the line ends; with a conversation behind it, listening resumes after the line anyway and the tap changes nothing.
units.entry: Voice buttons: AssistantChatView.swift:204, FitnessRecordingView+Tiles.swift:696, and EmuquApp.swift:750 (Watch voice tap)

branches.effect: preemptedState = .starting (voice starts after the line); a live prior → nothing

units.does: Starts a voice session: only from .idle, flips to .starting, clears permissionError, awaits mic+speech permissions, returns to idle (playing any trigger queued while starting) on denial, bails if state changed meanwhile, then clears transcript/response, refreshes language/voice, pins the STT provider, resets the announce flag and opens the mic. Coach triggers arriving while .starting are queued (handleTrigger), so they can no longer take over the state mid-start.

branches.effect: return silently: stop() moved state during the prompt

units.does: Reads preferredSTTProvider, resolves effective provider (WhisperKit falls back to Apple for non-English), stores useWhisperKitForCurrentSession, and if WhisperKit, prepares its model and resets its buffers.

Configures/activates the voice audio session, installs the interruption observer and launches openFirstTurn in a Task (first user turn, then the start chime, then queued triggers). On a thrown error releases the coordinator's .voice claim (registered before setActive), sets a localized permissionError and returns to idle (returnToIdleAfterFailedStart).

branches.effect: logs error, releases the .voice claim, permissionError='Couldn't start the mic: …', back to idle

units.does: A start that never opened the mic: sets .idle and plays any trigger queued while voice was starting.

Awaits beginUserTurn; plays the haptic + Tink start cue only if voice is then listening (the recognizer is live when the user starts talking; a failed or ended start plays none); then drains any coach trigger queued while voice was starting.

Full teardown: sets isStoppingFully for the duration, cancels the interjection llmTask, cancels the chat stream only when voice owns it (cancelVoiceOwnedReply; a typed reply keeps streaming), drops queued coach triggers, drops observers, resets cursor, stops TTS, removes the interruption observer, tears down audio, releases STT, returns to .idle and clears transcript/response/chunker/preemptedState.
units.entry: AssistantChatView.swift:485, FitnessRecordingView+Tiles.swift:681; internally from beginUserTurn failure/idle (Pipeline:402,408), audio interruption ended (Audio:87), empty-transcript give-up (Audio:332) and consent-required (Audio:521)

units.does: Cancels the shared chat stream (AssistantViewModel.cancel) only when voice owns it: voice is speaking a reply (activeAssistantIndex set) or a voice message is queued behind the stream. Otherwise only stops speech (stopAnyOngoingSpeech), leaving a typed reply and its queued follow-up alone.

branches.cond: voice speaking a reply OR a voice send queued

units.does: Resets WhisperKit buffers if this session used WhisperKit and clears the session STT pin.

User/barge-in interrupt: cancels the interjection task and the shared assistant stream with isStoppingFully set around the cancel (so the re-entrant stopAnyOngoingSpeech schedules no second listening restart), drops observers, bumps responseSpeakGeneration, stops TTS, clears response/chunker/partial transcript, and launches beginUserTurn as the only restart.

Entry for AI interjection prompts (interval calls, the post-workout recovery line): queues an .aiPrompt carrying the scripted fallback (queueTrigger) while voice is starting or the user/AI is busy; otherwise plays it now. `fallback` (nil for none) is the scripted line said instead when the AI can't be asked, fails, replies with nothing, or has said nothing by CoachCueSpeech.fallbackDeadlineNanoseconds.
units.entry: Called by WorkoutSessionLifecycle.announce(on:prompt:fallback:) (interval step / block-complete calls, with the scripted line) and WorkoutRecorder.speakHRRInterjection(samples:) (no fallback).

units.does: True while voice is .starting (any urgency: its audio isn't set up and preempting would abandon the start) or, for a routine trigger, while isBusyWithUserResponse.

Enqueues the trigger on pendingTriggers (VoiceTriggerQueue.enqueue: a route line replaces any queued route line; over capacity 8 the oldest scripted line is dropped first) and logs a warning with the drop count when any were dropped, logs the queue size; with voice idle (the only wait is a typed reply streaming) arms drainWhenTypedReplyEnds so the queue drains when that reply finishes.

branches.effect: warning log with the drop count

units.does: While no assistant observer is registered, registers one ObservationLoop on the chat's isStreaming; when it turns false with voice still idle, the observer cancels itself (cancelAssistantObservers) and drains the queue. Voice starting cancels it with the other assistant observers.
units.entry: Observation change delivery for the registered loop.

branches.cond: stream still running or voice not idle
branches.effect: ignore this change; else cancel observer and drain

units.does: Preempts for an AI interjection (preemptForTrigger), clears the response text and chunker, and starts the interjection stream with its scripted fallback.

Stores the scripted fallback on coachCue, then checks InterjectionGate for the active provider; refused → finishInterjectionAfterError (which says the fallback, if any). Allowed → sends a single-turn prompt with the context snapshot and the voice-coach system prompt to provider.send, stamps ttsStartedAt, replaces llmTask with a task consuming the stream, and arms the fallback deadline: if the interjection is still running and nothing has been said for it by then, finishInterjectionAfterError cancels the stream and says the fallback.

branches.effect: finishInterjectionAfterError() and return (fallback said when set)

branches.cond: deadline fired and llmTask still set
branches.effect: finishInterjectionAfterError() (which cancels the stalled stream); llmTask gone → nothing

units.does: Runs drainInterjection; a thrown stream error routes to finishInterjectionAfterError (never shown to the user; it says the fallback, if any), unless the task was cancelled (whatever cancelled it — a newer trigger, interrupt, stop, the fallback deadline — owns the state).
Iterates the interjection stream applying each event; stops if the task is cancelled; if the stream closes without .done and the task is still current, finishes the interjection.

branches.effect: return immediately, nothing finalized (caller cancelled it)

branches.cond: not cancelled and llmTask != nil after stream end
branches.effect: finishInterjection(); if .done already ran llmTask is nil and this is skipped

units.does: Dispatches an interjection stream event: textDelta → ingest, done → finish, toolUse/usage ignored.
Appends delta to currentResponseText and speaks any complete sentence the chunker emits.

Speaks the chunker remainder; when nothing at all was said for the interjection (no chunk, no remainder), says its scripted fallback instead (coachCue.takeFallback, app-language voice, scripted). Records the scrubbed full interjection text as lastInterjectionText, clears llmTask, and if still in .triggerSpeaking with no coach line speaking or waiting for the session, finishes the trigger immediately.

branches.cond: a fallback is still set (nothing was said)

branches.effect: finishTriggerSpeech() now; else the synthesizer delegate finishes it

units.does: Interjection skipped (gate), failed or stalled: cancels and clears llmTask (cancelLLM: a stalled stream stops; a finished or failing one is unaffected); says the scripted fallback when one is set (its finish then ends the trigger through the delegate); otherwise, once no coach line is speaking or waiting, ends the trigger as a finished line would (finishTriggerSpeech: the next queued trigger plays, or the prior state comes back — listening resumes after a live prior, .triggerSpeaking included; voice starts for a .starting prior; else .idle). While part of the reply is still speaking, the delegate's finish ends it.

branches.effect: speak it (scripted, app-language voice) and return
finishTriggerSpeech(); else left to the synthesizer delegate

units.does: Routes a spoken coach trigger: queued (queueTrigger, marked as a route line when isRouteLine so a newer route line replaces it and it expires) while voice is starting, or for a routine trigger while the user/AI is busy; otherwise an urgent trigger first saves in-progress dictation to the clipboard, and the line plays now.
Copies trimmed partialTranscript to the clipboard via PasteboardWriter (localOnly policy) when non-empty.
True when an interjection llmTask exists, the shared view model is streaming, or the synth is speaking in .speaking.

branches.effect: true (also true for a typed-chat stream with voice idle)

units.does: Preempts with a literal trigger line (preemptForTrigger) and speaks the message in the app-language voice as scripted.

Common trigger preemption: snapshots preemptedState once; when voice was speaking a chat reply, detaches from it (detachFromSpokenReply) so the reply stops feeding speech; cancels the interjection task, stops speech (stopSynthesizer, which also drops waiting coach lines, their audio-session holds and any armed fallback), kills the silence timer, starts a fresh recognition task only when the mic is live (not idle/starting), clears partialTranscript and sets .triggerSpeaking.

Stops voice speaking the chat reply in progress: bumps responseSpeakGeneration (in-flight observation callbacks no-op), cancels the assistant observers, clears the active index and spoken cursor, resets the chunker. The reply keeps streaming into the chat; after the alert voice listens again.

Delegates to VoiceTurnPolicy.isBusyWithUserResponse with state, llmTask presence, view-model streaming, whether speech is playing or a coach line waits for the audio session (coachCue.isBusy), and non-empty partial transcript.

Plays the next queued trigger still worth saying (popFirst drops route lines past their age) if the queue is non-empty and nothing is busy: a scripted line through playSpokenTriggerNow, an AI prompt through playAIPromptTriggerNow with its fallback. Returns true when one started; false when the queue is empty, voice is busy, or every queued line had expired.

branches.cond: queue empty, busy, or nothing live left after expiry

units.does: Returns true only if Flo is allowed (AssistantViewModel.aiIsAllowed with disclaimer) and the provider does not require data-sharing consent; logs the skip reason.
